claims.statement: Portrait of a woman from the Sforza court. The identification as Cecilia Gallerani is an interpretation that rests on the ermine emblem and a contemporary sonnet.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Stylistic dating; identification of sitter is interpretive.
